CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (EXEMPTION) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5A of the Control of Supplies Act 1961

[Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Exemption)

(Amendment) Order 2021.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 October 2021.

Amendment of paragraph 5

2. The Control of Supplies (Exemption) Order 1991 [P.U. (A) 77/1991], which is

referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended by substituting for

paragraph 5 the following paragraph:

"Exemption from

regulation 18 of the

Control of Supplies

Regulations 1974.

5. Any person who in the course of trade or business

purchases any scheduled article specified in column (1) of the

Third Schedule from the seller or supplier specified in

column (2) for the use specified in column (3) is exempted from

the application of regulation 18 of the Control of Supplies

Regulations 1974.".

Substitution of Third Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the Third Schedule the

following schedule:

"THIRD SCHEDULE

(Paragraph 5)

(1)

Scheduled article

(2)

Seller/Supplier

(3)

Use

1. All grades of petrol Petrol station Filling the vehicle's original

fuel tank for the purpose of

carrying out the function of the

vehicle

2. All grades of diesel

fuel

Petrol station Filling the vehicle's original

fuel tank for the purpose of

carrying out the function of the

vehicle

3. Sugar Wholesaler As ingredient for food and

beverages prepared by the hotel

operator for the purpose of

serving at the hotel

4. Wheat flour Wholesaler As ingredient for food prepared

by the hotel operator for the

purpose of serving at the hotel".

Made 14 October 2021

[KPDN.100-1/4/5; PN(PU2)188/XII]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Minister of Domestic Trade

and Consumer Affairs
